description: Update the Emails tab configuration for your GrowSurf program. Only the fields you send are changed; anything you leave out is untouched (arrays replace wholesale). Pass just the fields you want to change under `fields`. To see the full object with every field and its current value, fetch the tab first, then send back only what you want to change. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_update_campaign_emails

outputSchema.description: The full updated email configuration. Same shape as the `growsurf_get_campaign_emails` result.

title: Update Program Emails
